title: Composition of Streaming Runs
statement: For every bit string $x$, natural numbers $m,n$, and streaming seam state $s$, running $m+n$ rounds from $s$ gives the same final state and output as first running $m$ rounds from $s$ and then running $n$ rounds from the resulting state, with the two emitted bit strings concatenated in that order.
replaced:
Running $m + n$ streaming rounds from a state equals running $m$ rounds, then $n$
further rounds from the intermediate state, with the two output words
concatenated.
